Hi, I'm Rayan.

I'm a Grade 12 IB Diploma student working where AI, machine learning and language meet. I'm fascinated by how intelligent systems process human language, and how to make them fairer, safer and more useful. I've published research, built apps for farmers and Mandarin learners, and interned as a machine learning engineer.

Right now

Finishing the IB Diploma (Math AA HL, Physics HL, Chemistry HL, Economics, English Language & Literature, and Mandarin), graduating in June 2027.

学 Mandarin

Seven years of Chinese and counting. I'm working at roughly HSK 4 to 5 level, with a 2,500+ word vocabulary, which is why language keeps showing up in my research and projects.

Off the clock

Hip-hop on repeat, a growing vinyl shelf, a Batman figure collection, and far too many hours in Minecraft (Java Edition, obviously).

Research

Fairness and interpretability in AI.

Published · NHSJS, April 2026Gold CREST Award

Fairness and Dependency Preservation in Synthetic Credit Data

Can synthetic data safely stand in for real data in loan approval models? I compared SMOTE, CTGAN, TVAE and Gaussian Copula on the German Credit dataset and created a Dependency Preservation Score to measure how well each kept the relationships between credit variables intact.

The finding: every synthetic method distorted those relationships and made fairness less stable, so for high-stakes decisions like lending, original data with fairness-aware preprocessing is the safer choice. The work earned a Gold CREST Award from the British Science Association.

Read the paper PDF

Projects

Tech built for real people.

Live in every Indian state

AgriBridge

A multilingual Android app for Indian farmers earning under ₹10,000 a month. It helps them find nearby markets, government schemes and credit information in their own language, with a chatbot for quick questions.

I validated it with NABARD and three Farmer Producer Organisations in Karnataka, raised ₹1,20,000 to build it, and early results suggest around a 10% rise in income. AgriBridge is now available to farmers in every state in India. I presented it at the 64th UN Commission for Social Development in New York as a 1M1B Changemaker.

AndroidMultilingualChatbot

Mandalink

A full-stack web app for mastering radicals, the building blocks of Chinese characters, with interactive flashcards, AI-powered hints, timed challenges and animated stroke-order guides. The little scroll game in this room is a taste of it.

    What others say

    Try the idea

    A toy version of the question in my paper: does synthetic data keep the relationships between variables, and does fairness stay stable?

    Toy illustration. This uses a small made-up dataset generated in your browser and simplified stand-in generators, not the German Credit data, the real methods or the paper's score. For the real results, read the paper.

    How I built this site

    The whole site is one HTML file with no build step. The 3D room, Mandalink island, the rooftop and Bangalore are drawn with Three.js, and every model (the furniture, the creatures, the weapons, the city) is built from simple shapes in code rather than downloaded. Sound effects are generated live with the Web Audio API, progress is saved in your browser, and other visitors show up as ghosts through a small public message relay. There is a simple version for screen readers and keyboards, a reduce-effects setting for slower devices, and I test it with a headless browser.
